'''2007 US East Nationals Day 1 Justin Desai DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2007 US East Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' y=mx+b
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
